FLASHCARD SET · AGES 4–5

Early addition & subtraction — the parent shelf: 30 cards to download and print.

The whole math deck for printing at home: thirty addition-and-subtraction cards for ages four to five, each with its try-it job, its three pills — age, subject, level — its download button and one-tap printing; the library is the parents’ side of the class, so everything happens on this one shelf.

This is the parents’ copy of Class 46 · Early Addition & Subtraction: all thirty math cards on one shelf, ready to print. You do not need a plan — pick the sum tonight’s snack can act out, download the card, and print it full size on A4 or Letter paper. Every card carries one try-it job underneath and four pills on top: the age it suits, the subject it teaches, the grade level to start at, and the skill it builds. The download button takes the full-resolution JPG; the print button runs a single card through your printer with nothing else on the page. There are no card pages to hop through: the shelf is the whole set.

The shelf is yours; the lesson is your child’s. The class page at Early Addition & Subtraction teaches each sum the way a teacher would — the number story spoken out loud, the answer left blank on purpose, one real thing to count — while this wall simply holds the deck for printing. Same thirty cards, two jobs: the lesson lives in the class, the library is where parents print.

THE THREE LEVELS

Preschool, Grade 1, Grade 2.

Every card wears a level pill so tonight’s card takes one glance to choose. The levels are a suggested order, not a test — the sum your snack can act out is always the right card.

  1. 01

    Preschool · Name it

    the six sums to start with — all inside 5, the ones a four-year-old can count on one hand.

  2. 02

    Grade 1 · Do it

    the twelve doing sums — every fact inside 10, each one ready for fingers, snacks and counting-on.

  3. 03

    Grade 2 · Own it

    the twelve bigger sums — the make-ten pair and the whole take-from-ten family, the facts that make Grade 1 math feel easy.

THE ADDITION SHELF · 16 CARDS

Sums that build up.

Printable addition flashcards for kindergarten and preschool: every sum inside 10, from tiny 1-plus friends to the famous make-ten pair 6 + 4. The answer is never printed — working it out is the whole game, one card at a time. Download takes the full-resolution JPG; Print runs just that one card through the printer.

THE SUBTRACTION SHELF · 14 CARDS

Sums that take away.

Printable subtraction flashcards for ages 4–5: one-away sums to warm up, sneaking middles, and the whole take-from-ten family — the 10 − 3 card even ships as two drawings. Somebody is always sneaking out the door, and counting who stays is the game. Download takes the full-resolution JPG; Print runs just that one card through the printer.

Print a card here, teach the sum there: the Early Addition & Subtraction class is the lesson side of this deck — one sum a sitting, spoken to your child, counted out on real things. Once the deck is up on the fridge, the class page is the manual that makes each sum stick.
